info.name: imagegen
info.description: Local text-to-image and img2img with Z-Image-Turbo on Apple Silicon (mflux/MLX). Start `imagegen-api` first.

request.description: Which model is loaded, each model's weights_ready, quantization.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.images && b.images.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('imageName', b.images[0].name);

body.raw:
{
  "prompt": "A red fox resting in fresh snow under soft winter light, detailed fur, gentle bokeh",
  "width": 1024,
  "height": 1024,
  "seed": 42,
  "count": 1,
  "output_name": "fox",
  "model": "zimage"
}

request.description: Writes PNGs to outputs/ and returns their paths and download urls. Stores the first name in {{imageName}}. model: zimage (default) for people, photos, scenes and styles; steps defaults to the model's own.

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.images && b.images.length) pm.collectionVariables.set('imageName', b.images[0].name);

request.description: Boogu Image Turbo for text-heavy images: signs, posters, menus, labels, book covers. About 60 s per 1024x1024 image (8 steps); no img2img.

formdata.value: the same scene with warmer evening light
